title: Sentinel-6 CPOD Restituted Orbit Ephemeris (AX____ROE__AX)
description: Contains NRT Restituted Orbit State Vectors (OSVs) referred to the Centre of Gravity (CoG) of the satellite and expressed in the Earth-Centred, Earth-Fixed (ECEF) coordinate frame, packaged as a TAR archive comprising an XML manifest file and a measurement data file (EOF) with OSVs sampled at 10-second intervals, plus 5 OSVs overlap before and after the input GNSS data period. The collection is generated by the Copernicus Precise Orbit Determination (CPOD) Service within 10 minutes from the reception of GNSS Level-0 data, with a position accuracy threshold of 5 cm radial 1-sigma RMS.
